senses.gloss: (צְלָא) m. (צלי to stretch, v. צְלֵי II; cmp. מִשְׁכָא) hide, leather.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 11:32">Targ. Y. Lev. XI, 32</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 13:48">Ib. XIII, 48</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Nedarim 56b:2">Ned. 56ᵇ</cite> <he>ערסא דצ׳</he> a bedstead covered with skins.

B. Bath. 5ᵃ (prov.) ארבעה לצ׳ ארבעה לצְלָלָא four (Zuz) for dressing a large skin, four for dressing a small skin, i.e. do not claim anything for guarding your neighbor’s field enclosed within your fields, since you have no more expense by doing so; [oth. opin: four for the skin and four for the צַלָּלָא the tanner, v. comment.].—[צלין, Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᵃ bot., v. צַלְיָין.]
